description: The same rule binding on `.Done`, which DOES declare a payload field. Proves the code keys on the variant's payload-bearing-ness, not on the binding syntax.
rationale: §51.3.2 — a machine rule may destructure the payload of the variant it names. A unit variant carries no payload, so a binding group on it names fields that do not exist. Rejecting it is the same contract §51.0.B.1 enforces for engine state-children (E-ENGINE-PAYLOAD-ON-UNIT-VARIANT): a binding is a claim about the variant's shape, and the claim is checkable.
